v: Hype motham forget chesi chusthe Kabali is actually a slow family drama inside a mafia setup. Rajini gets room to ACT, and Radhika Apte sometimes even dominates him 🙏
e: Kabali is not the nonstop Rajini-style mass film the gigantic pre-release expectations conditioned many viewers to expect. Going in with zero expectations, I found a good, deliberately slow family story inside a gangster setting, with Rajinikanth showing vulnerability and acting rather than relying only on trademark style, and Radhika Apte giving him formidable company.
body:
watched #Kabali ……. It’s time for the Super Star to take a break & give time for his confused audience to decide in which roles they want to see their ageing star

thanks to all the negative buzzz…..i stepped into the movie with zero expectations and what i saw on the sliver screen was a beautiful family drama with emotions with a backdrop of mafia

yes the movie is sloowwwww, but that is how the majority of the Tamil movies are!!!! and Rajini nailed it (not with his usual style) with his acting, do you guys remember what was the last Rajini’s movie which had scope for him to showcase his acting (esp the way he was desparate 2 meet his wife)?? special mention of Radhika…she totally dominated Rajini in her screen presence

I hear people blaming on the PR team for huge publicity and setting high expectations…..come on, didnt you see how promotions happen for other movies??? n these poor guys just released a Teaser (mind it only a Teaser but not Trailer), there was no major audio release and no interviews from the star…then how can we blame them for over publicity?? Its just each n every one of us wanted to fetch limelight just by associating with the name called Rajini!!!!

so relax and enjoy the acting treat of Rajini daaa……..in short treat to Mass Masala n hard core Rajini fans in first n last 15 mins…..in between a good family story narrated in slow screenplay supported with superb acting from Rajini n Radhika….

v: Simply SUPERB!!!!! Nani acting FULL MEALS 🙏 Different concept, superb BGM, zero boring moments. Hero aa villain aa pakkana petti... NANI oka GOPPA ACTOR.
e: Gentleman felt wonderfully refreshing after a stretch of exhausting mainstream films. The different concept kept me engaged without a single boring stretch, Mani Sharma’s background score works beautifully and the supporting cast adds value — but the complete meal is Nani, once again proving that the hero-versus-villain label matters far less than the actor inside both possibilities.
body: watched #Gentleman……simply SUPERB!!! Nani acting Full Meals, Manisharma BGM superb…….special mention of Srinivas Avasarala n Heorine……personally I didnt had a single bore moment….SGS, Bhramotsavam, Sarrinodu lanti kalaa khandalu chusakaa it was obviously a refreshing movie with differnt concept……Final gaa NANI Hero no Villan’oo kadhu, oka gopaa Actor!!!!

v: Movie chusaka fans enduku ‘first watch then talk’ annaro ardham ayyindi 😂 Narakam close-up lo chusaka clarity vachindi. Bala Tripuramani song తప్ప almost everything exhausted me.
e: Brahmotsavam triggered one of my longest rants because I could find almost nothing to defend beyond the Bala Tripuramani song and Mahesh Babu trying something slightly different there. The screenplay feels shapeless, the huge cast and lavish settings add expense rather than value, familiar emotional beats repeat without impact and the film mistakes family-value speeches for actual storytelling.

v: SHELL SHOCKED!!!!! 🔥 Intha complex time-travel story ni banana peel chesinattu simple ga explain cheyyadam ela? Vikram Kumar + Suriya, take a BOW 🙏
e: 24 stunned me because Vikram Kumar takes a complicated time-travel story and communicates it with remarkable clarity. Suriya deserves enormous credit not only for performing it but for backing such an ambitious concept as producer. The CG could be better and the romance trimmed, but those reservations barely matter beside the excitement of seeing mainstream South Indian cinema attempt something this fresh.
body:
Shell Shocked!!!!just watched 24…..well how can 1 write such a COMPLEX story and how can 1 explain it just like that???? adedho china piladiki aarati pandu valichi petinatu….Take a BOW Vikram n Team!!!!

SURYA it takes GUTS to accept such stories without thinking about logistics and putting ur all hard earned money into it (not like our Tollywood super n Power Stars who think not taking remunaration makes them one of the producers) without thinking about Logistics!!!!

CG could have been better and romance track could have been trimmed…but who cares!!! Basically we are Telugu film audience maaku ilantivani chalaa kothaa….
